title: Chả cá Lã Vọng
intro: Chả cá Lã Vọng is a celebrated Hanoi speciality built around turmeric-marinated fish that's seared and folded through plenty of fresh dill and spring onion. Served over rice noodles with herbs, peanuts and a sharp dipping sauce, it balances warm spice with bright, fresh flavours in a way few other dishes manage.
